content:
I've recently been attempting to use the Lean 4 Game server online, but the editor will not show up. I've tried using chrome, firefox, incognito mode, etc. The screen stays like this :
image.png
and if I attempt to switch editing mode, nothing happens. The same error is displayed everytime, and I believe other people seem to be having the same issue based on the github issues thread. Is there a known fix to this?

Error:
PastedText.txt
Thanks for the report, I missed the Github issue. I'll have a look at the code and any recent changes which might have been made by colleagues recently.
i think i've seen this happen at least 3 weeks ago, so i believe it's not a super recent change that caused this...

there is at least an issue from 3 weeks ago which I completely missed :(

https://github.com/leanprover-community/lean4game/issues/445

Out of curiosity-- what could the cause of this issue be? It seems that it happened to different people at different times because I can distinctly remember using the game server multiple times over the last three weeks. However, it seems that once this happened on one of my devices, all of the devices I was using stopped working as well. However, based on how little this has been brought up, it seems not everyone is affected.

I am having the same issue, so I told two friends to check if it was working for them (it wasn’t). It was working on Monday and it is working on mobile though.
